definitions.explanation: The part that is on the outside or facing outward.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{外側|そとがわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}り{直|なお}す→塗り直す：noentry⟧。
examples.english: To repaint the outside of the building.
To wipe the outside of the window.

examples.japanese: ⟦カーブ→カーブ：27529_kaabu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{外側|そとがわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦タイヤ→タイヤ：06330_taiya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: On a curve, the stress is on the outside tire.

notes:
{外側|そとがわ} refers to the outside surface or exterior portion of something, as opposed to its interior.

FORMS:
⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧ (outside) + ⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧ (side). The pattern X{側|がわ} is productive for indicating sides or aspects.

CONTRAST WITH {内側|うちがわ}:
- {外側|そとがわ}: outside, outer surface
- ⟦{内側|うちがわ}→内側：05449_uchigawa⟧: inside, inner surface

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {外側|そとがわ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look from outside
- {外側|そとがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}く→向く：02304_muku⟧: to face outward
- {外側|そとがわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to clean the exterior
- {外側|そとがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧: to apply to the outside

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧: outside (general)
- ⟦{外部|がいぶ}→外部：00052_gaibu⟧: exterior, external (more formal)
- ⟦{表面|ひょうめん}→表面：03587_hyoumen⟧: surface
